title: Finite-Node Perverse Schobers and Corrected Extensions for Conifold Degenerations
summary: We study one-parameter conifold degenerations whose central fiber has finitely many ordinary double points. Working within a deliberately minimal finite-node bulk/localized-sector formalism, we identify the first categorical layer suggested by the corrected finite-node perverse extension and its mixed-Hodge-module package.
